# Third-party GNU Go source

The School of Go interface treats GNU Go as an independent game-engine component.

Runtime files served by this repository:

- `/gnugo.js`
- `/gnugo.wasm`

Corresponding upstream source:

https://github.com/TristanCacqueray/wasm-gnugo

Reference revision:

`382df5a9b14b62ea451012ec7d2e81c61162e037`

The source metadata for this integration is stored in `gnugo-source/`.

When a project-specific GNU Go build is introduced, modified source files and reproducible build instructions must be added there.

See also:

- `/GNU_GO_NOTICE.md`
- `/COPYING-GNUGO.txt`
